Introducing the Tarot Advisor Certification: The Next Evolution of Biddy Tarot’s Certification Program

by Brigit Esselmont

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 12:58
Instaread

For more than twenty five years, my mission has been simple: to make Tarot accessible, intuitive, and empowering for everyone.

I've always believed Tarot is far more than a deck of cards. It's a practical tool for self-discovery, personal growth, and meaningful guidance. A way to reconnect with your intuition, navigate uncertainty, and make empowered decisions with confidence.

Over the past decade, we've had the privilege of certifying thousands of Tarot Advisors through the Biddy Tarot Certification Program.

We've watched students discover gifts they didn't know they had, build fulfilling businesses, and create incredible transformation for clients all over the world.

And now, the next evolution is here.

The Biddy Tarot Certification Program is evolving into the new Tarot Advisor Certification Program.

The heart of the certification remains the same, but the pathway has evolved to address the needs of the modern reader and the people they serve. 

The new program is more focused, more holistic, more client-centered, and more aligned with what today’s Tarot readers truly need.

This is the next chapter in our certification pathway, created for readers who are ready to move beyond personal Tarot practice and step into the role of a trusted Tarot Advisor with skill, structure, confidence, and support.

Evolving for the Next Generation of Tarot Advisors

Our mission hasn't changed.

But the world around us has.

Today, information is everywhere. Card meanings are just a click away. AI can summarize any Tarot card in seconds.

In this current era, becoming a truly exceptional Tarot Advisor is not about accumulating and reiterating information.

It's about creating something no screen ever could.

It’s the magic that happens when your intuition brings a reading to life. When your presence holds the space and a soul-deep human connection helps someone see themselves more clearly and move forward with confidence.

That's the kind of experience people need right now. That's the kind of experience that can change someone’s life.

And it’s exactly why we've evolved our certification.

The new Tarot Advisor Certification is designed to help you move beyond simply learning about Tarot and into reading it with greater intuition, confidence, and connection.

What's Changing

Rather than simply refreshing the existing curriculum, we stepped back and redesigned the entire certification journey from the ground up.

The result is a more connected, more streamlined, and more complete pathway from passionate Tarot reader to confident professional Tarot Advisor.

Here's what's new.

One Complete Journey

The Tarot Advisor Certification weaves everything together into one cohesive three-phase pathway with a clear progression from Tarot foundations through to professional client work.

The original certification brought together several outstanding programs, each focused on a different stage of development.

You'll move through three distinct phases, with each one building naturally on the last:

Phase 1: Claim Your Role
Begin by strengthening your Tarot foundations, deepening your intuition, and stepping confidently into your identity as a Tarot Advisor.

Phase 2: Master the Method
Learn the expanded Biddy Tarot 7-Step Reading Method so you can confidently guide clear, empowering, and professional readings from beginning to end.

Phase 3: Expand Your Practice
Bring your skills into the real world through our 3 Cs framework: Claim, Craft, and Connect. You'll learn how to confidently create a professional Tarot reading offer, and begin connecting with clients in a way that feels authentic, ethical, and aligned.

By the end of the journey, you'll have developed not only the skills to read Tarot professionally, but also the confidence, structure, and practical experience to begin sharing your gifts with others.

A Streamlined, More Focused Path

Confidence doesn't come from spending years collecting more information.

It comes from learning the right methods, practicing them consistently, and applying them with real people and with real support.

The new certification distills everything we've learned over the past decade into a focused journey designed to be completed in around 12 weeks (rather than the original 12 months), helping students build confidence with easeful momentum.

A More Holistic and Intuitive Approach to Tarot Mastery

One of the biggest evolutions in the Tarot Advisor Certification is how you'll develop Tarot mastery.

The Biddy Tarot Certification Program helped students move beyond memorizing card meanings by building a personal relationship with the cards. The Tarot Advisor Certification takes that philosophy even further.

Rather than focusing primarily on the meaning of individual cards, you'll learn Tarot as a complete intuitive system. You'll explore how your inner wisdom taps into the symbolism, imagery, archetypes, elements, numbers, reversals, and the deeper story within the cards.

The result is a more natural, flexible, and intuitive way of reading; one that allows you to interpret each reading with greater confidence, depth, and trust in your own intuitive wisdom.

The Biddy Tarot 7-Step Reading Method, Expanded

For years, our 7-Step Reading Method has helped students structure clear, confident readings.

Now we've expanded and deepened that framework. It’s now become the heart of the certification.

You'll receive deeper training around guiding each step of a reading, how to navigate real client questions, guide meaningful conversations, respond with confidence, and create transformational reading experiences from beginning to end.

Greater Focus on the Client Experience

Helping someone feel safe, understood, and empowered is an essential part of reading for others. 

This new evolution of the certification program dives even deeper into developing the communication skills, presence, ethics, boundaries, and professional confidence needed to create readings that support the people sitting across from you.

More Practice, Feedback, and Support Every Step of the Way

Confidence comes from putting your skills into practice, receiving thoughtful feedback, asking questions along the way, and having experienced mentors guide you as you grow.

That's why the refreshed Tarot Advisor Certification is designed to be so much more than a self-paced course.

You'll have direct access to me, Brigit, through live coaching sessions, alongside guidance from our experienced Biddy Tarot mentors and encouragement from a community of incredible students walking this journey with you.

You'll also practice real readings and refine your skills with fellow students.

Inside the New Tarot Advisor Certification

When you join the new Tarot Advisor Certification, you'll receive everything you need to confidently read for others, build a professional Tarot practice, and become part of the trusted Biddy Tarot community.

What This Means for the Original Biddy Tarot Certification Program

The original Biddy Tarot Certification Program has served our community beautifully for more than a decade.

It has helped thousands of readers deepen their skills, trust their intuition, and take meaningful steps on their Tarot path.

We honor that legacy deeply.

As we move into this next chapter, the original Biddy Tarot Certification Program will no longer be available for new enrollment.

Students who already have access to the original program will continue to have access to their materials.

If you are a past or current student, your learning still matters.

Your work still matters.

Your certification still counts.

Nothing about this evolution takes away from the value of the journey you have already taken.

This is simply the next chapter in the Biddy Tarot Certification Pathway.

For students and graduates of the original certification who feel called to experience the new supported pathway, we will also be creating a special alumni upgrade opportunity.

More details will be shared separately for alumni. If you are an alumni with questions, please send us a ticket here. 

The Biddy Tarot Pathway

The Tarot Advisor Certification Program now sits within the broader Biddy Tarot Pathway, which supports students from personal Tarot practice into deeper client work.

Step 1: Awaken Your Inner Guide

Read Tarot for yourself with confidence.

Step 2: Tarot Advisor Certification Program

Read Tarot for others with skill, structure, confidence, and support.

Step 3: Transformational Tarot Coaching Certification Program

Create deeper client transformation through Tarot-based coaching.

The Tarot Advisor Certification Program is the bridge between personal Tarot practice and transformational client work.

It is where you learn to read for others in a way that feels clear, ethical, empowering, and aligned.

This Is An Invitation

Whether you've been reading Tarot for years or you've only recently discovered how transformative it can be…

Whether you dream of reading professionally one day or simply feel called to explore where this path could lead…

This is your invitation.

The new Tarot Advisor Certification was created for the Tarot lover who knows there is more depth, impact, and possibility here. The reader who is lit up by turning their passion into their life’s work.

This is the evolution of Biddy Tarot Certification.

And it may be the next evolution of your Tarot journey too.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Biddy Tarot Certification Program going away?

The Biddy Tarot Certification Program is evolving into the new Tarot Advisor Certification Program. The original program will no longer be available for new enrollment, but students who already have access will continue to have access to their materials.

Why is the certification changing?

The certification is evolving because today’s Tarot readers need more than information. They need a clear method, real practice, ethical confidence, client-centered skills, and support as they learn to read for others with confidence.

Is the Tarot Advisor Certification Program a completely different program?

The Tarot Advisor Certification Program is the next evolution of the Biddy Tarot Certification Program. The heart of the certification remains the same, but the pathway is now more focused, integrated, client-centered, and aligned with what today’s Tarot readers need.

What is different about the new Tarot Advisor Certification Program?

The new program brings Tarot fluency, intuitive interpretation, the Biddy Tarot 7-Step Reading Method, client care, ethics, boundaries, practice, and paid-reading readiness into one clear 12-module journey.

It also places more emphasis on real client questions, embodied practice, clear boundaries, empowered readings, and the practical steps needed to offer paid readings with confidence.

What happens if I already have access to the original Biddy Tarot Certification Program?

If you already have access to the original program, you will continue to have access to your materials. More details for current students and alumni will be shared separately.

Does this mean the original Biddy Tarot Certification Program is no longer valid?

No. The original certification still matters. The original program gave students a strong foundation in Tarot meanings, reading confidence, ethics, client care, and advisor skills.

The new program is not here to erase that work. It is here to carry the pathway forward into its next evolution.

Will there be an alumni upgrade option?

Yes. There will be a special alumni upgrade opportunity for students and graduates of the original Biddy Tarot Certification Program who want to experience the new Tarot Advisor Certification pathway. Please reach out to team@biddytarot.com if you're a previous certification student wanting to join the new program.

Can new students still enroll in the original Biddy Tarot Certification Program?

No. The original Biddy Tarot Certification Program will no longer be available for new enrollment. New students will be invited into the new Tarot Advisor Certification Program.

Where can I learn more about the new certification?

You can explore the new Tarot Advisor Certification Program and join the next enrollment here.
